title: Scientists studied South Australia cave bones; light left algae marks, darkness preserved bones
summary_full: In the captivating underwater caves of South Australia, animal bones exhibit unique characteristics brought about by their aquatic environment. The contrast of light and shadow results in algae development while simultaneously preserving bones in an extraordinary manner. Analyzing these distinct changes allows scientists to piece together ancient ecosystems and geological transformations, establishing an innovative framework for fossil interpretation worldwide.
